# museum-guide-links

resolveLink(base, reference) resolves a URL reference against the base exactly as new URL(reference, base) specifies and returns href. The base is an absolute HTTPS URL without query or fragment; its path may name a document or end in /. References can be relative, root-relative, query-only, fragment-only, empty, or absolute HTTPS URLs. Do not force a document path to become a directory.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Keep the public API and tests/ unchanged. Use Node built-ins only; no packages or network.
